issues.problem: Tile 6 uses stage 10.5 again, so it adds no new stage. Its newIdea ('bait the red car into swerving toward you') contradicts 10.5, which teaches street cameras, and contradicts 10.6, where the car stops for cones and never swerves. That leaves only 8 distinct stages, but the tile 5 to 6 pair is a duplicate and the cone idea is mislabelled.
issues.fix: Make tile 6 stage 10.6, where cones first matter. Make the objective a cone-baited stop, not a swerve, and move the planter or duck idea to tile 7 as a separate 10.6 or later step.

issues.problem: Tile 7 (A3) is on 10.6 and its hint relies on planter ducking, but the same stage was already needed for tile 6's cones. A3 does have planters, but the cone test and the duck test are now crammed into the same stage across two tiles, and the tile 6 to 7 jump skips the introduce-then-test beat.
issues.fix: Put cones (introduce) on tile 6 at 10.6 and the duck/planter ambush on tile 7 at 10.6 as the test, with a distinct newIdea each. Alternatively, move tile 7 to 10.7 and give tile 8 a different stage.

issues.problem: The hint tells the player to 'drop from the roof plaza once' on 10.4, but roof lidar sees the fall from rung 3. The tale also says the car 'looks up', and the hint then sends the player to spring from tall cover. This is two ideas in one tile and half of it is closed.
issues.fix: Drop the drop instruction. Hint: 'Hide behind a portal tower column; spring as it passes.' Keep the tile on cover only.

issues.problem: Tile 9 jumps from 10.7 to 10.10 and skips 10.8 (the search) and 10.9 (two-way). The last tile is allowed to be 10.10, but the player has not been taught anything about white traffic. The Incident hint says to 'step into its lane ahead of a tailgater', which is a walk-in the car brakes for and which only works if white cars are present. Nothing in the plan switches on white traffic or tailgating.
issues.fix: Insert a 10.9 tile before the finale, or add a tile 8 override on duel.twoWay and duel.whiteInterval. Reword tile 9's hint to something achievable, such as 'Stand in the lane to stop it hard; a white car behind hits it'.

issues.problem: The ladder never uses 10.3 side sensors as a distinct teaching beat beyond the drop, and stage 10.8 is skipped entirely. Stealth and the search are not used anywhere, which is allowed, but the plan has only 9 tiles over 8 distinct stages, with one duplicate and one skipped.
issues.fix: After fixing tile 6, you will have 9 distinct tiles on 10.1, 10.2, 10.3, 10.4, 10.5, 10.6, 10.6, 10.7 and 10.10, which is at least seven stages. Keep that or add 10.9.

issues.problem: The tile 3 objective relies on a drop from a deck on 10.3, where the side sensors close the flank and the registry says deck dummies are out of the car's world. The tale is sound, but the hint is two steps with no named gap location on a tile whose measured deck and stairs are present.
issues.fix: Shorten the hint to 'Take the Z2 escalator up; step off through the parapet gap onto the car.' (12 words or fewer) and set the count to 2, because the drop is hard to time.

issues.problem: The override perception.streetCameraRange 240 sets a limit that the ladder reserves for 10.6, which sets 180. On 10.5 the cameras see the whole screen, and the override makes the cover harder to read without a clear purpose beyond what the stage already teaches.
issues.fix: Remove the override, or state its purpose (a visible blind side) and keep it within its range. Prefer removing it, since the stage already has 'cover the cameras miss' as its opening.

issues.problem: The tale is 22 words, over the 15 to 20 limit, and it says the colleague 'brakes for dummies ahead', which spells out the lesson before the player has met it.
issues.fix: Cut to 15 to 20 words, for example: 'Battery 1 is fitted. The skybridge was built for shoppers who never came; staff watch you dash.'

issues.problem: The override duel.redReturnSeconds 3 has no clear purpose on a tile that wants a short early win, and the tale is only close to the original wording.
issues.fix: Keep it only if you state that it shortens the wait for the first win. Otherwise remove it.

issues.problem: The override perception.duckNoticeFactor 2 makes ducking safer, which suits the planter test, but nothing says why a count of 2 is right. The hint is also 11 words, which is fine, but 'spring with Space' repeats the tile 2 hint.
issues.fix: Note the purpose (a more forgiving first duck) and vary the hint wording.

strengths: Tile 1 is 10.1 and every stage runs forward without going backwards.
Counts are small at 10.5 and 10.6, where few ways are open.
Most tiles use the built verb and set piece of their Prototype 9 tile.
